name: Zombie Wave Survival
desc:
Use code OMEGA for free shards!

ENDLESS ZOMBIE WAVES. SURVIVE OR DIE.

🔫 Unlock and upgrade powerful weapons
⚔️ Choose your class, each with unique abilities
🛡️ Build turrets, barriers & healing stations
📦 Loot supply drops mid-wave
🏆 Climb the leaderboards

Survive endless zombie waves in the ultimate zombie survival shooter. Every wave gets harder. Earn Shards, unlock gear, and outlast everyone.

How long can YOU survive?
